There are various phrasal verbs that are used to talk about different things. In this lesson, we've talked about phrasal verbs for talking on the phone and for talking about health. Let's review.

Phrasal verbs are constructed with:
verb + particle/preposition
The verb by itself has one meaning and takes on a different meaning when put together with the preposition.

Here is list of phrasal verbs for talking on the phone and one list for talking about health.

There is a difference between Zero Conditional sentences and other conditional sentences.

In the Zero Conditional, the condition is always true. The Present Simple tense is used.
In other conditional sentences, there may or may not be a possibility in the future that the condition will happen.

These are words you use to give advice on being healthy.
to sleep longer than usual on a day off
Example: I slept in this morning so that I could work hard tomorrow.
to return to a task you were doing a little while ago
Example: I got more sleep today so that I could get back at it tomorrow.
to do something you didn't do enough of before
Example: Have you caught up on your beauty sleep?
an expression based on the belief that more sleep makes you more beautiful
Example: I'm glad I got my beauty sleep. I think I look better today.
Example: I need to slow down at work so that I don't get so exhausted.
Example: If I drink any more, I think I'll pass out.

Instructions: Complete the following steps. Fill in the Self Assessment.

images.text:
Vanessa: Hey, Dad.
Dad: Hi, Vanessa. Nice to see you on videochat again. You're not working today?
Vanessa: No, I slept in so I can get back at it tomorrow. How are you holding up?
Dad: I'm superb. If I take it easy every day, I don't stress my heart.
Vanessa: That's great to hear. If I were you, I would work in the garden and take easy walks in the park.
Dad: Yeah, I'm doing that. The doctor said that if I take moderate walks daily, it builds up my heart's strength again.

Vanessa: Can I talk to Mom?
Dad: Yeah, hold on a second. She's right here. Honey, Vanessa would like to talk to you.
Mom: Coming. Hi, Vanessa. It's delightful to see you. Have you caught up on your beauty sleep?
Vanessa: Yeah. I was so exhausted before. I definitely need to pace myself at work so that I don't pass out.

Mom: If you don't stop overworking yourself, you'll retire early like your dad.
Vanessa: I know. If I won the lottery, I would open up my own restaurant and monitor it over a webcam from Martha's Vineyard.
Mom: If you had your own business, it would become your passion.
Vanessa: I guess so.
